claims: In Latin, "re" means "with regard to" or "in the matter of".
Latin "re" is commonly used in correspondence.
"Re" is a musical note that is a variant of "ray".
"Re" is slang for "re-rock" in drug context.
The prefix "re-" indicates repetition or reversal.
"Re:" is used at the start of emails or legal documents to mean "in the matter of" or "about".
In online games like League of Legends, "re" is used to indicate an enemy has "re-emerged" or come back into the lane.
"Re" is the second note of the solfège scale.
The second note of the solfège scale is also spelled "ray".
The Egyptian sun god Ra is sometimes spelled "Re".
Île de Ré is an island in France.
The prefix "re-" can be pronounced with a long "e" (re-edit).
The prefix "re-" can be pronounced with a short "e" (represent).
The prefix "re-" can be pronounced with a schwa "uh" (rely).
The pronunciation of the prefix "re-" depends on stress and word origin.
